 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order
Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
The applicant has filed this first application under Section 439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.
Applicant has been arrested on 23.04.2024 by Police Station Garh, District Rewa in connection with Crime No.163/2024 registered for offense under Sections 376(1) of IPC.
The prosecution story in nut shell is that on 21.04.2024 applicant came to her house when she was alone and committed rape with her.
When husband of 2 MCRC-24545-2024 the prosecutrix came there, applicant fled away from the spot.
On that basis, aforesaid complaint was registered against the applicant as mentioned above.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 23.04.2024.
Charge-sheet has already been filed in the case.
It is further submitted that complainant had borrowed money from the applicant and applicant was demanding it back.
There was a dispute between the parties for last three month, due to which a false case has been registered by the complainant against the applicant.
The applicant is first offender.
He is a permanent resident of District Rewa and there is no chance of his absconsion.
He has no criminal antecedents.
It is also submitted that there is no likelihood of his absconding leaving behind his family, home and property.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to the applicant and his family.
Therefore, the applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
P er contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application.
Hence, no case for grant of bail is made out.

After going through the contents of the case diary and looking to the facts and without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac o nly) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following 3 MCRC-24545-2024 conditions by the applicant:-
1.
The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
